risks.title: Goodwill Impairment
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to goodwill impairment risks due to uncertainties in fair value estimates of acquired assets, particularly related to the Worldpay acquisition and previous acquisitions. Citation: "These projects carry the risks associated with any development effort, including cost overruns, delays in". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: The company faces potential goodwill impairment charges due to uncertainties in fair value estimates of acquired assets.

risks.title: Risque de change
risks.score_rationale: The company operates globally and is exposed to foreign currency fluctuations that can impact revenues and operating results across multiple currencies. Citation: "The risks identified below are not all encompassing but should be considered in establishing an". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: The company is vulnerable to foreign exchange fluctuations affecting its international operations.

risks.title: Risque fiscal
risks.score_rationale: The company faces tax risks from complex tax law interpretations and potential timing differences between tax deductions and actual tax payments. Citation: "Legal, Regulatory Compliance and Tax Risks • Our business is subject to government regulation and". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: The company faces risks from complex tax law interpretations and potential timing differences in tax deductions and payments.

risks.title: Risque lié aux actifs incorporels
risks.score_rationale: The company holds significant intangible assets subject to regular impairment testing with uncertain value estimates, particularly from the Worldpay acquisition. Citation: "Risks Related to Our Capital Structure • Our substantial indebtedness could adversely affect us and". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: The company is exposed to intangible asset risks from regular impairment testing and uncertain value estimates.

risks.title: Risque réglementaire
risks.score_rationale: The company faces evolving and complex payment industry regulations that could impact operations, compliance costs and financial performance. Citation: "Legal, Regulatory Compliance and Tax Risks • Our business is subject to government regulation and". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: The company faces regulatory risks from evolving payment industry regulations that could impact operations and financial performance.

risks.title: Risque d’intégration d’acquisition
risks.score_rationale: The company faces risks from integrating acquisitions such as Worldpay, which could have significant impact on operating results and financial position. Citation: "The acquisition and integration of Worldpay involves a number of risks". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: The company faces risks from complex acquisition integrations, particularly the integration of Worldpay and potential synergy realization.

risks.title: Risque de contentieux
risks.score_rationale: The company could be exposed to litigation that could negatively impact its reputation and operating results. Citation: "Any future misuse or compromise of personal information stored on those systems, or any other". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: The company is exposed to litigation risks that could impact its reputation and operating results.

company_description: Global Payments Inc. provides payment technology and software solutions for card, check, and digital-based payments in the Americas, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific. It offers authorization, settlement and funding, customer support, chargeback resolution, reconciliation and dispute management, terminal rental, sales and deployment, payment security, and consolidated billing and reporting services. The company also provides an array of enterprise software solutions that streamline business operations of its customers in various vertical markets; and value-added solutions and services, such as point-of-sale software, analytics and customer engagement, payroll and reporting, and human capital management. It markets its products and services through direct sales force, trade associations, agent and enterprise software providers, referral arrangements with value-added resellers, independent sales organizations, payment facilitators, and financial institutions. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
